_comment: Which games to watch and what counts as cheap. Games are matched by opponent name against the live MaizeTix schedule, so game IDs are never hardcoded and this survives a season rollover.

notify._topic: Intentionally absent. This repo is public and the ntfy topic name is the only thing protecting your feed, so it comes from MAIZETIX_NTFY_TOPIC -- a gitignored .env locally, a GitHub Actions secret in CI.

behavior._realert: Re-alert on an already-seen listing only if it drops at least this many dollars below the price we last alerted at.
behavior._expiry: Games are skipped once their date has passed. When every enabled target is in the past, the run reports season_over so the cron job can be retired.
